descriptions.code: Ask a coding agent to write, fix, refactor or test source code
descriptions.note: Just a remark or reference to remember; no action requested
descriptions.research: Ask an AI agent to investigate, look up, survey or compare information
descriptions.schedule: An appointment or meeting at a specific date and time
descriptions.todo: A personal to-do the user will do themselves (buy, reply, check, update, read)

instructions: The user pressed a hotkey while looking at their screen and spoke this short voice note. What kind of follow-up does the note ask for? Classify the requested action even when the Japanese note is short or omits particles. Reading or checking something later is a personal todo. Choose note only when no action is requested; do not treat an explicit future action as just a bookmark.
name: explicit-followup-en-v2
